criterion.name: completeness_and_coverage
criterion.description: Address the full scope of the task in the user’s query, covering all major elements specified in the prompt as well as relevant visual aspects and contextual cues.

lineage.source: Multi-Crit: Benchmarking Multimodal Judges on Pluralistic Criteria-Following

criterion.name: visual_grounding_and_details
criterion.description: Reference observable elements in the image such as objects, spatial relationships, colors, or text, and bases its description or analysis on these details.

lineage.source: Multi-Crit: Benchmarking Multimodal Judges on Pluralistic Criteria-Following

criterion.name: factuality_no_hallucination
criterion.description: Avoid visual or factual errors, ensuring all details and claims are presented in the image or reasonably supported by the prompt.

lineage.source: Multi-Crit: Benchmarking Multimodal Judges on Pluralistic Criteria-Following

criterion.name: creativity_and_expressiveness
criterion.description: Demonstrates imagination and originality when appropriate, or precise and knowledgeable articulation for analytical tasks, while remaining contextually appropriate.

lineage.source: Multi-Crit: Benchmarking Multimodal Judges on Pluralistic Criteria-Following

criterion.name: clarity_and_coherence
criterion.description: Communicates ideas clearly and logically, with fluent language, well-organized structure, and smooth flow of information.

lineage.source: Multi-Crit: Benchmarking Multimodal Judges on Pluralistic Criteria-Following
